I'll start this before the rush begins.
Isla glances at her pending errands, choosing instead to focus on the grid before her day accelerates.

Take a breath. No point in chasing the clock.
With her morning schedule slipping, she resists the urge to slam her laptop shut and rush off.

Three minutes of steady is all I need.
Ignoring the urgent notification, Isla carves out three steady, deliberate minutes for herself in the nook.
